custom_logic_notes: Uses CExpert framework from MQL5 Standard Library with CSignalBlauErgodicMDI custom signal module. CExpert handles OnTick processing, position management, and order execution internally. Signal uses Ergodic MDI main/signal line crossovers. Trailing stop module (CTrailing) and money management module (CMoney) are attached but trailing value is 0 (disabled by default). DecreaseFactor controls lot sizing: negative values use fixed lots, positive values compute as fraction of free margin. Signal reversal closes opposite positions before opening new ones. SL/TP values are in points and require digit adjustment (multiply by 10 for 5-digit brokers).
python_conversion_notes: Must recreate the Blau_ErgodicMDI custom indicator from its .mqh source - it computes a smoothed MDI (Momentum Displacement Index) with triple smoothing (R, S, U periods). The CExpert framework's signal/trailing/money module pipeline must be reimplemented: signal generates long/short conditions, trailing manages SL modification, money computes lot size. DecreaseFactor conditional sizing logic: if negative, use fixed StopLoss*TakeProfit lots; if positive, compute lots from free margin percentage. SL/TP values are in points not pips - need adjustment for 5-digit symbols. The CSignal module uses previous bar values ([1]) for crossover detection to avoid repainting.
